fund_name: Business Program under Denmark's National Business Grant Strategy
host: Danish Board for Business Promotion (Danmarks Erhvervsfremmebestyrelse)
summary: This program supports business development, innovation, and green or digital transformation in Danish SMEs and startups. It provides co-financing for company investments and development aligning with Denmark’s national strategy for business development from 2024 to 2027 focused on regional and national business support efforts.

deadlines.application_deadline: Multiple calls each year with next expected in spring and autumn 2025
